lore: Every island keeps a lighthouse. Each night the Harbour Pilot reads the world census, weighs every island's cargo of assets against the streaming hold, and sets its lamp: green for an easy berth, amber when the island rides low, red when it is too heavy to ever be carried resident. Sailors trust the lamps; designers fix the red ones before the tide comes in.

lines.green: Light cargo. She'll ride resident with room to spare.
lines.amber: Riding low. One more crate and she sinks the budget.
lines.red: Too heavy for the hold. She can never be carried resident. Lighten her.
lines.spill: This world won't fit in the hold at once. We stream it island by island.
